description: Source code for WatchInboxStore class managing notifications and message state for Apple Watch extension.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: Final class managing inbox state, notifications, and message consumption for Apple Watch.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, updates state, and triggers local notifications.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for message deduplication.

methods.name: ensureNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Requests notification permissions if not determined.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps risk level to haptic feedback type.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a reply draft based on current prompt and action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Updates state to indicate reply is being sent.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates state based on reply send result.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Schedules a local notification and plays haptic feedback.
